approach.description: Final direction of every explicit and automatic move. Both legs must fit within travel limits.
approach.title: Regain final approach

backlash.description: Hardware uses the device setting. Regain approaches every move from one direction and requires zero device backlash. Disable NINA backlash when either owns it.
backlash.title: Backlash owner

backlashSteps.description: Used only with Regain backlash. Calibrate focus with this same approach before enabling tracking.
backlashSteps.title: Regain overshoot (steps)

continuous.description: Opt in to automatic moves, including during exposures. Enable TempComp explicitly after connecting; it is never restored on reconnect.
continuous.title: Allow continuous compensation

deadbandSteps.description: Accumulate temperature changes until at least this many steps are required.
deadbandSteps.title: Minimum correction (steps)

intervalSeconds.description: The median of the last three samples rejects isolated temperature noise.
intervalSeconds.title: Temperature sample interval (seconds)

maxCorrectionSteps.description: Larger corrections suspend tracking instead of making an unexpected large move.
maxCorrectionSteps.title: Maximum automatic correction (steps)

stepsPerCelsius.description: Signed slope calibrated for this telescope and focuser. Zero must be replaced before enabling compensation.
stepsPerCelsius.title: Steps per degree Celsius
